title: The Zócalo’s FIFA Fan Fest Reports Full House for the Last Match of the 2026 World Cup
author: Elba Mónica Bravo
content:
_This article by Elba Mónica Bravo originally appeared in the[July 19, 2026
edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/07/19/mundial/fifa-fan-fest-
del-zocalo-recibe-a-cientos-de-aficionados-para-el-ultima-partido-del-
mundial-2026), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

The 23 degrees Celsius, with a heat index of 24, do not stop hundreds of
people from staying at the FIFA Fan Festival Zócalo to watch the Spain-
Argentina match, the final of the Soccer World Cup. The first fans arrived
before six in the morning, having preferred to make their way to the Zócalo
rather than stay home, for "the atmosphere" and because "the Zócalo is the
Zócalo."

The Plaza de la Constitución was painted green by the jerseys worn by the
diehards of the National team, which did not reach the final, which is why
some attendees expressed feeling sadness. Fans also arrived wearing La Roja,
of the Spain team, and the blue and white of Argentina.

The sound of trumpets, the "viva México" chants, and even the singing of the
National Anthem have been heard at the FIFA Fan Festival of the Zócalo.

Noé, from Naucalpan, said he arrived before six in the morning, that he "feels
bad" about the absence of Mexico in the final. For Noé, who maintains that
Argentina is a better team than Spain, "it was proven that the best stadium is
the Zócalo."

From Magdalena Mixiuhca came Amed Gómez and Sandra Hernández, dressed in the
Cruz Azul jersey, because one has to show off that it is the Liga MX champion.

Also from Naucalpan came Cecilia and José with their son Johan Leonel, who
wore the Spain jersey. They said that "living the final in the Zócalo is
something historic," even including the experience of enduring a long line,
shoving, and a chaotic entrance to the Zócalo, where access was allowed
moments before eleven in the morning.

Fidel Torres, from Gustavo A. Madero, said,

> "I love the soccer atmosphere of the Zócalo, I prefer it a thousand times
> over the stadium."

## The Zócalo Filled Up

The Secretariat of Comprehensive Risk Management and Civil Protection
announced that the FIFA Fan Festival Zócalo is full, so it asked fans to go to
other soccer festivals to avoid crowding.

The city agency indicated, "the Zócalo has reached its maximum capacity, you
can enjoy the final of the FIFA 2026 Soccer World Cup on the screens placed on
the surrounding streets or at the soccer festivals."

People on their own, families, and groups of friends arrived at the Zócalo
from before six in the morning. At halftime, the presenters indicated that the
Zócalo had reached its maximum capacity.
